definition: a sparkling drink made from pear juice
description: In an old stone barn at dusk, lit by lanterns, a young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper, a leather apron and green rubber boots laughs as she pulls open the wooden tap of a big barrel. A pale golden, fizzy drink gushes out in a thick stream into a wooden tub, which fills with froth and overflows onto the floor. Crates of green pears stand nearby and bunches of pears hang from the beams. Friends at the open door to the orchard cheer, and a dog lies on the floor.
